author: NingMeng123
purpose: 023矿物生成、矿石数值和现代高度适配独立规格。原始分布与现代适配必须区分。

candidate_sampling.underworld_frequency_multiplier: 8 when world.underworld_y_offset!=0 and generator != gravelGen; adamantium additionally times 2
candidate_sampling.legacy_decorator_seed: (long)(originX + originZ*65536) + worldSeed*0x100000000L; int addition/multiplication overflow before long cast
candidate_sampling.source_original_default: abw constructors always assign120 to underworld_y_offset in underworld; offset0 branches remain evidence-only, not new-save defaults

height_sampling.underworld: adamantium -> random.nextInt(16+120); any apr ore -> random.nextFloat()<0.75f ? random.nextInt(136) : random.nextInt(256); non-apr -> random.nextInt(256)

vein_sampling.small_scale_branch: if((float)baseSize*scale<=3.0f && random.nextInt(2)==0) { if(random.nextInt(2)!=0) return success_with_zero_blocks; scale*=2.0f; }
vein_sampling.growth: recursive six-face random walk: place current node; at most16 attempts/node; axis=random.nextInt(3), sign=random.nextInt(2)==0?-1:1; recurse with remaining budget; break at exact requested budget
vein_sampling.failure: remaining<1, invalid position or wrong replacement consumes no random and places nothing
vein_sampling.underworld_gravel: must_be_supported; no placement at y<1 or if below is air/passable including liquid
vein_sampling.dirt_surface: if sky visible above, desert/desert_hills use sand; other biomes grass; otherwise dirt

drop_mechanics.normal_metal_output: one intact ore block, not raw metal or nuggets; netherrack gold also intact ore block
drop_mechanics.fortune: chance=1.0f+fortuneLevel*0.1f; every original unit drops once and independently duplicates once if random.nextFloat()<chance-1.0f; at most two per original unit
drop_mechanics.placed_metal_fortune: when idDropped==blockId and metadata bit1 (value1) set, chance=1.0f
drop_mechanics.xp: XP item reward times original num_drops, extra fortune copies do not count; metal ore item0, coal0, redstone0, diamond30, emerald20, quartz10, lapis5 per unit
drop_mechanics.explosions: diamond/emerald/quartz -> corresponding shard; coal -> nothing; lapis3..5; other metal ore blocks; superclass chance remains1 for stone material
drop_mechanics.skill_branch: only if actual world.areSkillsEnabled() && player lacks MINING; must not enable solely because this branch exists
drop_mechanics.infested: no item drop; source stone dimension variants include HoarySilverfish/Copperspine and Nether Netherspawn
drop_mechanics.copper_infested_reaction: natural ordinary infested stone within3 in XYZ of copper may change to Copperspine; copper break/explosion checks neighbors; preserved evidence for mob phase

smelting.furnace_system_scope: 矿石配方、产出和来源炉温数据可在023接入；完整R196炉体、燃料热值与热级服务端检查需要对应炉体系统实现，不得把普通配方冒充已实现炉温

modern_adaptation.random_source: Minecraft feature random draws one nextLong to seed java.util.Random per ore feature; oracle validates explicit Java Random inputs rather than original whole-world positions

overworld_height_mapping.purpose: 原始0..64矿层扩展到现代-64..64，64以上保留地表参照；不是改变现代地形生成器

underworld_height_mapping.scope: 该批矿石分别明确映射已采样的旧世界层号，不能再加120

modern_adaptation.vein_shape: 每个递归相邻节点保持现代1格六面连接；只映射起始层号，不放大成2格或1.5格间距
modern_adaptation.depth_scale_uses: sampled legacyY and R196 min/max, not modernY
modern_adaptation.stone_variants: 新增silver/mithril/adamantium含stone与deepslate身份；两种底材使用相同源硬度和原资源图，不增加深板岩矿石硬度倍率
modern_adaptation.modern_only_ore_content: 古代残骸等1.6.4不存在的矿物保留现代规则，并明确其后续成长平衡状态；不是R196来源值
modern_adaptation.modern_mountain_mapping: mite:has_emerald_ore包含原版1.21.1实际绿宝石生成的10个群系，读取WG地表群系而非固定Y64地下群系
modern_adaptation.infested_mobs: 现代银鱼可承载023生成验证；HoarySilverfish/Copperspine/Netherspawn的独立战斗机制需明确后续状态

native_ore_bypass_control.fossil_mineral_overlay: coal palette converted to bone instead of coal/diamond ores

validation_status.manual_confirmation_scope: 用户确认023当前交付正常并授权提交；不补写每个场景、双客户端联机或旧存档的独立通过记录

runtime_scope.source_mineral_hopper_experience: successful extraction immediately emits result XP in front of the furnace; failed extraction and history do not pay
